value.rationale: The exact factorization converts the source paper's overshoot-versus-fragility motivation into a sharp structural law. Derivative feedback can enlarge the stable stepsize ceiling toward \(4/L\), but it simultaneously raises \(q_\lambda\) and worsens the best scalar factor to \(\sqrt{q_\lambda}\). This is a directly interpretable boundary and tradeoff for the published optimizer.
